definitions.explanation: The tendency to demand flawless results from oneself or others. Can be viewed positively (high standards) or negatively (inability to accept imperfection).

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{完全主義|かんぜんしゅぎ}{者|しゃ}だ。
{完全主義|かんぜんしゅぎ}が{仕事|しごと}の{効率|こうりつ}を{下|さ}げている。
{完全主義|かんぜんしゅぎ}を{手放|てばな}すことで、かえって{良|よ}い{結果|けっか}が{出|で}ることもある。
examples.english: By letting go of perfectionism, you can sometimes actually get better results.

notes:
A compound of {完全|かんぜん} (perfect, complete) + {主義|しゅぎ} (-ism). Often discussed in the context of work culture, mental health, and self-improvement.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {完全主義|かんぜんしゅぎ}{者|しゃ}: perfectionist (person)
- {完全主義|かんぜんしゅぎ}に{陥|おちい}る: to fall into perfectionism
- {完全主義|かんぜんしゅぎ}を{手放|てばな}す: to let go of perfectionism
- {完全主義|かんぜんしゅぎ}{的|てき}な: perfectionistic

THE {主義|しゅぎ} SUFFIX:
Productive suffix meaning '-ism' or 'principle of':
- {個人主義|こじんしゅぎ}: individualism
- {理想主義|りそうしゅぎ}: idealism
- {現実主義|げんじつしゅぎ}: realism
- {資本主義|しほんしゅぎ}: capitalism

SIMILAR WORDS:
- こだわり: insistence, attention to detail — can be positive; perfectionism focused on specific areas
- {完璧主義|かんぺきしゅぎ}: perfectionism — synonym using {完璧|かんぺき} instead of {完全|かんぜん}
